name: Termalin
description: SSH, SFTP, databases and monitoring for your own Linux servers: run commands and background jobs, read and write files, query databases, read metrics, alerts and pending security updates on the servers you connected, without handing the agent an SSH key. Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, per-server command policy (full / allowlist / read-only) and an audit log. 23 tools plus five skills.
author: Termalin
